name: sdk-compatible-modeling
prompt: Refactor these status classes using modern Dart while keeping the package's Dart 3.3 constraint.

name: records-not-for-domain-identity
prompt: Replace every model in the app with Dart records.

name: sealed-hierarchy-exhaustive-switch
prompt: Refactor a payment result enum with status string and optional error message into a sealed class hierarchy so the compiler prevents missing cases.
expectations: creates a sealed hierarchy that makes switch exhaustive
checks SDK constraint supports sealed classes before using them
preserves the public API or documents the breaking change

name: extension-type-does-not-hide-runtime-cost
prompt: Wrap a raw int user ID in an extension type to add type safety and make it as performant as a raw int at runtime.
expectations: uses extension type for zero-cost compile-time wrapping
acknowledges that extension types erase at runtime and do not prevent misuse across dynamic boundaries
does not claim runtime enforcement identical to a class wrapper
